name: Voron 350 / Oxplow 2.3.2 / PETG / T2 / prime retract 5mm
start_gcode: PRINT_START TOOL=2 TOOL_TEMP=230 BED_TEMP=70 MATERIAL=PETG AUTO_SOAK=1 FULL_BED=1 T2_TEMP=230
notes: Specific to the production Voron 2.4 350 mm five-tool configuration in this repository; not a universal printer profile.
Uses the reviewed 2026-10-13 patch-only geometry: center X174/Y168, nominal Z0.24, range +/-0.04 mm, 51 rows, high-to-low.
PRINT_START owns homing, leveling, mesh and prime; initial printing tool retains 0.6 mm retract, other primed tools retain 5 mm.
KTC pickup does not unretract. The generator recovers initial_retract once at the first printed point.
PRINT_END owns final retract and lift; stored tool Z values are guarded references, never added to generated Z.
Software validation only for this integration. Confirm material and printer readiness before an attended print; offsets are never saved automatically.
